seo.title: Scrap Metal Recycling Melbourne | Hallam Yard | Metal Werx
seo.description: Sell scrap metal in Melbourne: drop it at our Hallam yard (open Mon–Sat) or book a bin or pickup in the south-east. Paid same day by bank transfer.

hero.title: Get Paid for Scrap Metal in Melbourne's South-East
hero.description: We buy ferrous and non-ferrous metals at our yard in Hallam, serving Melbourne's south-east. Bring your scrap in, hire a bin, or book a pickup. Paid by bank transfer the same day; bring photo ID.

whyUs.heading: Why Metal Werx
whyUs.intro: Selling scrap should be simple. Here is how we make it that way.

reasons.title: We Buy It All
reasons.description: Copper, brass, aluminium, stainless and HMS steel, motors, compressors, air conditioners and engines.

reasons.title: We Come to You
reasons.description: Book a pickup or hire a bin, and we collect the scrap from your home or site.

reasons.title: Built for Business
reasons.description: Regular collections and bins for workshops, builders, factories and other commercial customers.

commercial.heading: Commercial and Industrial Customers
commercial.intro: We offer a range of services to make recycling your scrap more convenient and rewarding.

cashForCars.heading: Scrap Copper
cashForCars.body: Copper pays more per kilo than any other common scrap metal. Bring in your pipe, wire and offcuts, and we'll grade it, weigh it and pay you for every kilo. Sorting it before you come in can lift the price of the whole load.

steps.title: Bring It In
steps.description: Bring your scrap to our Hallam yard in the car, ute or trailer. For bigger loads, we can collect.

steps.title: We Sort and Weigh It
steps.description: We sort your metal by grade and weigh each grade on its own, so every kilo is paid at the right price.

points.text: Graded by how clean it is
Each grade weighed on its own

steps.title: Get Paid
steps.description: We pay by bank transfer the same day. Bring photo ID and your BSB and account number.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Can't find your answer here? Get in touch and we'll help.

questions.question: What metals do you buy?
questions.answer: We buy ferrous and non-ferrous metals, including copper, brass, aluminium, stainless steel, HMS steel, electric motors, compressors, air conditioners and aluminium engines.

questions.question: Do you pick up scrap?
questions.answer: Yes. We collect scrap from homes, workshops and commercial sites. Book a pickup and we come to you.

questions.question: Can I hire a bin for my scrap?
questions.answer: Yes. We have bins in different sizes, though most jobs end up with a 1 m³ or a 2.4 m³ bin. We drop it off, you fill it, and we collect it when it is full.

questions.question: Do you take gas bottles?
questions.answer: No. We can't take gas bottles or LPG tanks, even empty ones, at the yard, in our bins or with a pickup. Your gas supplier or local council can tell you where to drop them off.

questions.question: How do I get a quote?
questions.answer: Contact us through the website, call 0470 131 025 or email info@metalwerx.com.au with what you have.
